faqs.q: How do you tell storm damage from normal wear on a Montclair roof?

runs.v: Storm damage shows a pattern: hail leaves random-pattern circular bruises with granule loss, wind damage concentrates at roof edges, rakes, and corners where uplift peaks, and debris impact leaves directional damage, per IBHS wind and hail research. Uniform deterioration across the roof reads as wear.
